run_track_jobs: run datatrove track_jobs to monitor job progress in a logging folder
run_track_jobs_continuous: run datatrove track_jobs with interval to continuously monitor job progress
run_track_jobs_glob: run datatrove track_jobs with glob pattern to track multiple job directories
run_track_jobs_single: run datatrove track_jobs once without continuous monitoring
run_track_jobs_invalid: run datatrove track_jobs on a path with no executor.json to see error message
